messages:
maya (PM): ACME pressed again: they need SSO + tenant logs to start pilot. Can we scope into MVP or push to v1?

diego (eng): Full SAML+SCIM+audit = ~2 sprints. Risky for this ship.

nora (security): Minimum compliance for pilot: tenant-scoped admin logs + auth events. SAML can be deferred if we provide OAuth with documented controls.

maya (PM): Proposal: "MVP compromise" = OAuth-only SSO + 7d tenant audit (login, token_revoke, config_change). Feature-flagged + canary for ACME.

diego (eng): That reduces work to ~1 sprint. Needs feature flag, small admin UI, and audit schema.

sam (support): Support impact: need runbook + sample queries. I can prep onboarding materials if eng gives endpoints.

infra-bot: Note: Deploy checklist requires TLS certs and secret rotation plan when auth changes shipped.

nora (security): Add CI test for cross-tenant reads; retention policy enforced by infra.

maya (PM): Action items: maya update tracker + acceptance criteria; diego spike for schema & perf (due Tue); nora security checklist (due Tue); sam onboarding doc (due Wed).

diego (eng): Rollout plan: feature_flag "oauth_sso_pilot", canary to ACME for 72h, auto-off on error spike >1% or auth latency +200ms.

maya (PM): We'll mark as constrained MVP change. If pilot fails or legal insists, schedule full SAML/SCIM for v1. I'll confirm with ACME and set 30m sync tomorrow.

sam (support): I'll draft pilot invite copy and incident escalation steps.

diego (eng): Quick dev note: defer SCIM and long-term retention to v1 to avoid infra schema migration now.

maya (PM): Thanks team  keeping this minimal to preserve ship date. :thumbsup:
